title: tesi
summary: An Italian thesis repository (largely TeX) containing a markdown research artifact that surveys synthetic data generation approaches for organized retail distribution (GDO) data. The document recommends and quotes example code for SDV's CTGANSynthesizer as the top-quality option, but the repository shows no code that actually runs it.
